assessments.reasoning: The object model permits an empty set of slots and makes code optional. The paragraph defines each slot as a name-value pair. The later distinction among data objects, ordinary methods and block methods preserves the role of optional code.

challenge.method: Read the slot and code qualifiers independently and compare the adjacent object categories.
challenge.results: Neither nonempty slots nor code is compulsory in the cited object model. Code-bearing methods do not alter the general rule. Named slots do not establish physical storage or field layout.

limitations: This is the documented object model. No VM representation was inspected or measured.
